For the 5% who teach

Become A Creator & Teacher of Knowledge

You learned it. You lived it. Now teach it — and build the cipher with the people. Contact Devine personally at any step of your journey.

1. The Teacher's Path

You only teach what you have memorized and lived. 0–120°: memorize it word for word. 120–240°: comprehend it and live it. 240–360°: teach it and build it. Nobody teaches from degree 10.

2. One Degree A Day

Take one degree each day. Build on it in your own words — the meaning, the application, the question it answers. Post it. Day by day, the people's cipher grows toward 360.

3. How To Make A Teaching

Step 1: pick the degree. Step 2: write the understanding in your own words. Step 3: add a real-life application. Step 4: add one question for the people to reflect on. Step 5: record it and post it.

4. Formats That Work

Short video builds. Multi-clip reels stitched on one theme — each clip picking up exactly where the last ends. Carousel pages. Written lessons. One theme at a time.

5. Build Your Cipher

Start your own circle. One rule: build, don't tear down. Show up daily. Teach the 5% — and reach the 85%.

6. Get Paid For Teaching

Price your knowledge. Sell direct — text, Apple Pay, QR. Deliver it personally. Your teaching is your business.
